symptom: create or modify of a nanoflow drawn with @position on every statement, adding an if/else after the declare without @position and editing the two calls in the next if's branch: `spliced: 1 inserted, 1 replaced, 1 dropped`, with `if $Flag` -299 -> 40, its merge 186 -> 525 and the return 530 -> 869, while the replaced calls stayed at (-124, 100)/(60, 100), left of their own decision. Re-running the same script was refused (`the connectors of the If at (40, 200) are redrawn`). With a plain if (no else) the new if took over the stored decision and the restated `if $Flag` was drawn on top of it at (-299, 200), both merges at (186, 200).
cause: Three rules that each held alone. makeRoom shifts every top-level node past the cut by the deficit (339); a Replace whose first statement states @position is Placed and written at its stated coordinates, never shifted; movedNode records a move only when the stated position differs from the stored one, so the shifted nodes were never moved back, and the merge is not a move candidate at all. On re-run @merge is geometry but not a position field, so the pair fell to `redrawn`. No-else: lcsStatements weighed ifConditionChanged the same as sameIfShell and the tie went to the earlier pair, so the new if became a condition edit of the stored decision and the restated if a Placed insert, which never runs checkRoom.
file: mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice.go (Pin, pinnedPast, makeRoom, Replace), mdl/backend/microflow_mutation.go (MicroflowMutator.Pin), mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify_patch.go (statedPoints, patch), mdl/executor/cmd_flow_modify.go (lcsStatements weights, mdl 1 gate in planFlowModify)
insight: Shift-consistently cannot satisfy idempotence: once the script states -299 and the store says 40, the re-run must move it back or refuse — measured even for a plain one-activity insert into a described flow (+104, then the re-run refused on @merge). So a node at a stated point is pinned and a shift that would move one is refused, naming the room and the node; the mutator pins by point rather than $ID because the node at a stated point may be one a later Placed fragment puts there. Collect stated points from @position, @merge, @start, note and parameter positions, skipping loop bodies (relative coordinates). The control is the same script with the positions after the insert left out: spliced, everything moved by one delta, re-run Unchanged. Gate the pins on mdl 1 (flowRebuildRefused.Applies): under mdl 0 the refusal falls back to the whole-flow rebuild, which deletes the Studio Pro merges and $IDs the shift kept — TestFlowModify_InsertIsSpliced (ADR-0012's describe+insert acceptance, headerless) caught exactly that, and ADR-0011 forbids the change of meaning. Not touched: the shift still moves parameters (y 53) along with the row.
